variants.suspected_cause: The ordinary aztec36 standalone link places externally declared globals in a local packed DATA table; the large-data profile may preserve target A4 identities differently.
variants.controlled_change: Change only the compiler profile from aztec36 to aztec36-large-data while keeping the source bytes identical.

predicted_effect.note: The target-width A4 operands may bind under a profile with a different data model while preserving the 1608-byte payload.
